description: This line plot illustrates the training loss over time for two models, "Vanilla" and "SepLLM", as they train for up to 250,000 seconds. The x-axis represents "Training Time (s)" on a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 250,000 seconds, with tick marks at intervals of 50,000 seconds. The y-axis represents "Loss" on a linear scale, ranging from 2.40 to 2.75. The "Vanilla" model is depicted by a purple line with triangle markers and a solid line style, starting at a loss of approximately 2.75 and decreasing to about 2.50. The "SepLLM" model is shown by a red line with circular markers and a solid line style, beginning at a loss of approximately 2.75 and also decreasing to about 2.50. A green dashed horizontal line is drawn at a loss value of 2.50, and a green dashed box highlights the region from 200,000 to 250,000 seconds, with an annotation indicating a 1.26x multiplier, likely referring to the ratio of loss values between the two models at the end of the training period.
